summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments on load testing workflows, then refactor the api-client package from a module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios per CipherBoxClient, and investigate a throttle bypass gap discovered during load testing.
summary.outcome: All PR review threads resolved and pushed. The singleton/dual-path architecture was fully eliminated: api-config.ts now creates one shared axios instance used by both direct generated-function calls (web app) and CipherBoxClient operations. The throttle bypass gap investigation concluded the issue was already fixed by the refactor, with a bonus fix migrating bare axios.post() calls in ipfs/index.ts to use the instance-scoped axios.

repo: Two layers of rate limiting exist in the API: controller-level @UseGuards(ThrottlerGuard) and per-endpoint @Throttle() decorators — BypassableThrottlerGuard.canActivate() returns true before super.canActivate(), so @Throttle metadata is never consulted when bypass header is present.
The IPFS controller uses only JwtAuthGuard with no throttle guard, so IPFS operations are never throttled by the API layer.

Phase 19.1 was listed as complete in ROADMAP.md (6/6 plans) but the web app still had 13 files importing directly from @cipherbox/api-client, meaning the rewiring was partial — scoped to folder/file/bin CRUD but not auth, vault setup, shares, invites, device approval, or health checks.
The web app's dual-path architecture (direct api-client imports + CipherBoxClient) had persisted through at least one prior refactor before this session fully eliminated it.
CipherBoxClient did not have axios as a direct dependency — AxiosInstance type must be imported through @cipherbox/api-client, not directly from axios.
429 errors during pnpm test runs are caused by parallel test suites hitting the live API simultaneously, not code issues — a brief cooldown between runs resolves them.

code.finding: Rewrote to support both singleton and instance-scoped paths: createAxiosInstance now handles 401 refresh, setApiClientConfig accepts optional pre-built instance, getCachedInstance uses createAxiosInstance instead of duplicating interceptor logic.
addToIpfs and unpinFromIpfs used bare axios.post() instead of ctx.axiosInstance, bypassing auth interceptors and 401 refresh even though IPFS controller has no throttle guard.
createAndPublishIpnsRecord, batchPublishIpnsRecords, and resolveIpnsRecord all needed ctx parameter threaded through to forward the axios instance to customInstance options.
loadBinMetadataInternal and saveBinMetadata called resolveIpnsRecord and createAndPublishIpnsRecord without passing ctx — missed in initial pass, caught by grepping all IPNS callers.
Mock assertions expected ipnsControllerPublishRecord called with one argument; after ctx threading it's called with two (data + undefined options) — assertions needed updating.
Rewrote to create the shared axios instance with all interceptors (auth injection, 401 refresh) and register it via setApiClientConfig, eliminating duplicate instance creation.
BypassableThrottlerGuard returns true before calling super.canActivate(), meaning per-endpoint @Throttle() limits are never applied when bypass header is present — the guard is correct.
curl -s silently succeeds on HTTP 5xx — must use curl -fsS so server errors correctly fail the readiness health check loop.

workflow: When grepping for callers of a refactored function, also check internal package callers (e.g. sdk/src/bin) separately from the primary package — easy to miss in a monorepo.
Rate-limited live API integration tests require isolation (run package alone with cooldown) to distinguish transient 429s from code issues.
The check-todos workflow uses a GSD toolchain (gsd-tools.cjs) to load todo state and integrates with ROADMAP.md for phase correlation before offering actions.

friction: sdk/src/types.ts initially used import('axios') for AxiosInstance type — failed because axios is not a direct SDK dependency; had to use the re-export from @cipherbox/api-client instead.
sdk-core/types.ts had same dynamic import issue with axios.
Parallel pnpm test runs consistently produced 429 errors from the live API, requiring manual cooldown and isolated reruns to confirm tests actually pass.
IPNS callers in sdk/src/bin/index.ts were missed in the initial ctx-threading pass, requiring a follow-up grep sweep to find them.
ipns.test.ts mock assertions broke after ctx threading because undefined options argument changed call signature — required a test fix pass.
open_items: setApiClientConfig and the singleton export still exist in api-client for backward compatibility — could be removed entirely once confident no external consumers rely on it.

The web app still has 13 files importing directly from @cipherbox/api-client (auth, vault setup, shares, invites, device approval, health checks) — these share the singleton but are not routed through CipherBoxClient, which may be revisited as Phase 19.1 follow-up.
Parallel test suite 429s suggest the integration tests may benefit from a shared rate-limit-aware test runner or per-suite cooldowns rather than relying on sequential execution.
The ROADMAP.md shows Phase 19.1 as '6/6 plans complete' (planned) with unchecked boxes — the roadmap state may need reconciliation to reflect what was actually completed vs. planned.
